nodes.name: Inbound SMS Webhook (one per number)
nodes.notes: Point each client number's inbound-SMS webhook here (Twilio form, Telnyx message.received, or generic JSON).

nodes.name: Route Reply
nodes.notes: STOP/START/HELP centrally, then pick the automation. Logs data/logs/router.jsonl

nodes.name: Central or Forward?
nodes.notes: 0 handled here (keywords / owner fallback), 1 forward to automation

nodes.name: Forward to Automation (internal webhook)
nodes.notes: Local call to the same n8n (no external traffic). The target automation does its own test-mode logging.

nodes.name: Test mode?
nodes.notes: true = log only, nothing is sent

nodes.name: TEST: Log Would-Be SMS + Owner Alert
Live: Route by Provider
nodes.notes: 0 Twilio, 1 Telnyx, 2 no SMS / unknown provider

nodes.name: Twilio: Send SMS
nodes.notes: DISABLED. Add a Twilio credential and enable for live sends.

nodes.name: Telnyx: Send SMS
nodes.notes: DISABLED. Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Enable for live sends.

nodes.name: Owner Alert Email (SMTP)
nodes.notes: DISABLED. Add an SMTP credential to email owners.

parameters.content:
## Inbound-SMS Router
One inbound URL per client number: /webhook/sms-in?business_id=...
STOP/START/HELP handled here once (shared opt-out list). Other replies go to the automation that most recently texted this number (reminders / reviews / missed-call), with intent overrides (C/R/cancel/late -> reminders, ratings -> reviews). Unknown, stale, or tied -> owner alert, no auto-reply.
Test mode ON: nothing is sent.

main.node: TEST: Log Would-Be SMS + Owner Alert
